As a Module Developer, you'll take the requirements provided by the customer and implementation team and configure the platform to make these processes work digitally. This may include building forms, setting up workflows and approvals, creating business rules, and configuring what happens after a form is submitted. The platform can also automate emails, notifications, reporting, and workflow actions. For example, when a resident submits a form, the system can automatically send a confirmation email, notify the appropriate department, trigger the next step in the process, or capture information for reporting. In simple terms, you'll help take a manual government process and turn it into a digital, automated workflow inside the SaaS platform. This is not a traditional software development role. You will primarily be configuring and building solutions within an existing SaaS platform rather than developing an application from scratch. What You'll Do Configure and build software modules based on customer requirements and specifications. Translate business requirements and workflow documentation into functional SaaS configurations. Build and configure online forms, fields, workflows, approval processes, and business rules. Configure automated emails, notifications, routing, and other workflow actions. Support reporting requirements and data-driven workflows. Apply HTML and SQL when needed for advanced configurations, data handling, validation, and customization. Review requirements and identify gaps, inconsistencies, or areas requiring clarification. Work closely with Implementation Consultants and Implementation Analysts throughout the build process. Clarify requirements and communicate potential issues early in the implementation process. Perform self-QA and functional testing before handing completed configurations to the next stage of implementation. Maintain clear documentation of configuration decisions, build notes, and processes. Manage multiple module builds and priorities while meeting project deadlines. Collaborate with Product and Support teams to stay current on platform updates and new capabilities. Contribute to improving configuration standards, templates, and internal processes. What We're Looking For Experience in SaaS implementation, software configuration, technical implementation, application administration, business systems, or a similar role. Experience translating business or customer requirements into a working software solution. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow detailed requirements and specifications. Ability to understand business workflows and translate them into system configurations. Experience managing multiple projects, configurations, or workstreams simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable working with cross-functional teams such as Implementation, Business Analysis, Product, QA, and Support. Ability to learn proprietary software and new technologies quickly. Willingness to work US hours . Technical Skills Required / Preferred: SaaS platforms and software configuration Workflow configuration and automation HTML – preferred SQL and basic data concepts – preferred Data mapping and validation Conditional logic and business rules Jira, Wrike, or similar project management tools Low-code/no-code platform experience is a plus Experience with platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics, Microsoft Power Platform, Appian, Mendix, OutSystems, Pega, or other configurable SaaS platforms is also valuable. Why This Role? This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving business problems through technology and wants to work at the intersection of software, implementation, and process automation. You'll help transform how local governments operate by taking processes that were previously handled through paper forms and manual processing and turning them into digital, automated workflows. If you've worked with SaaS implementation, software configuration, business systems, technical consulting, application administration, CRM platforms, workflow automation, or low-code/no-code solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

Die konkrete Höhe wird basierend auf Kriterien wie z.B. Qualifikation, Verantwortungsbereich und den Anforderungen der Position festgelegt. Gerechtfertigte Abweichungen sind im Einzelfall möglich

review_candidates.title: Administrador/a Linux
review_candidates.description: ¿Te gustaría formar parte de una empresa global líder en innovación y tecnología intralogística? Mecalux es una de las empresas más destacadas a nivel mundial en el mercado de sistemas de almacenaje, con más de 60 años de experiencia. Es pionera en la implementación de tecnologías avanzadas para el diseño, fabricación y comercialización de soluciones logísticas, incluyendo almacenes automáticos, software de gestión y estanterías metálicas. Como parte de nuestro crecimiento, estamos buscando profesionales con talento que deseen unirse a un equipo dinámico en expansión, con visión de futuro y un compromiso firme con la innovación y el desarrollo. Actualmente en el Departamento de IT estamos buscando un/a Administrador/a de entornos Open Source en nuestra sede de Cornellà de Llobregat (Barcelona). ¿Cuáles serán tus principales funciones? Técnico/a de sistemas de entornos Open Source Linux (Redhat principalmente) Monitorización de rendimiento y estabilidad. Colaboración con equipos de Desarrollo para la optimización del rendimiento de las aplicaciones. Instalación de software, parches y upgrades de versión de SO y BBDD. Troubleshooting y resolución de problemas. Scripting (Bash, Perl, Python, etc.) Administración de BBDD: MySQL, Oracle.. Gestión de aplicaciones Open Source: Redmine, Alfresco, Git, Jenkins, Solr. ¿Cuáles son los requisitos mínimos? CFGS o Formación Universitaria en Informática, Telecomunicaciones o similar. Experiencia mínima de 3 años en entornos Open Source Linux. Capacidad de comunicación en inglés a nivel lectura y escritura. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Participación en proyectos innovadores y de gran interés profesional, con una de las empresas líderes del sector. Integración en equipos altamente cualificados y en constante evolución. Un entorno de trabajo colaborativo, dinámico y de crecimiento continuo. Contrato indefinido y jornada completa. Modalidad híbrida de teletrabajo. Un salario competitivo, acorde con la experiencia y el perfil de cada candidato/a. Plan de retribución flexible. Te brindamos la oportunidad de impulsar tu carrera en el dinámico sector de la logística, uno de los más prometedores en la actualidad. Si buscas crecer profesionalmente en un entorno de constante evolución, ¡nos encantaría contar contigo en nuestro equipo! En Mecalux tenemos un compromiso con la igualdad de género. Por ello, nuestra voluntad es promover activamente la participación de mujeres y hombres en nuestros procesos de selección y así mismo, garantizar que éstos sean justos y objetivos sin distinción de sexo, orientación, identidad, colectivo, expresión de género o cualquier otra característica protegida por ley.

review_candidates.title: Senior Storage Consultant / Commvault Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Inetum’s team of 28,000 consultants and specialists strive every day to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector entities and society. Inetum’s solutions aim at contributing to its clients’ performance and innovation as well as the common good. Present in 19 countries with a dense network of sites, Inetum partners with major software publishers to meet the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility. Driven by its ambition for growth and scale, Inetum generated sales of 2.5 billion euros in 2023. Job Description We are looking for an experienced Senior Storage Consultant / Commvault Specialist to join our Infrastructure Services Operations team. In this role, you will serve as the operational subject matter expert for enterprise storage, backup, recovery, and cyber resilience platforms, with a strong focus on Commvault technologies. You will be responsible for supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, and continuously improving enterprise storage and data protection environments. Your primary focus will be ensuring service availability, operational stability, compliance, and customer satisfaction while providing expert support for mission-critical infrastructure. Qualifications Responsabilities: Operate and support enterprise storage environments. Perform proactive monitoring and health checks to ensure platform availability and performance. Troubleshoot and resolve complex incidents affecting storage infrastructure. Conduct root cause analysis and participate in problem management activities. Perform capacity management and provide recommendations for storage optimization. Execute firmware upgrades, patch management, and operational maintenance activities. Support storage-related change requests and ensure successful implementation within established processes. Maintain operational documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles. Participate in on-call support and major incident resolution when required. Ensure compliance with SLAs, operational standards, and governance requirements. Administer, monitor, and support Commvault backup and recovery environments. Ensure successful execution of backup, restore, replication, and retention processes. Perform backup troubleshooting and recovery operations for enterprise customers. Manage upgrades, patches, and day-to-day platform maintenance. Monitor backup success rates and proactively address failures and operational risks. Execute and document recovery testing and disaster recovery exercises. Support hybrid and cloud-based backup environments. Maintain backup policies, retention schedules, and compliance requirements. Participate in major incident handling and recovery activities. Provide operational support for cyber recovery and ransomware protection solutions. Support regular testing of recovery procedures and business continuity capabilities. Additional Information Fluent in English, both written and spoken. More than 5 years of professional experience in backup administration and support, with strong expertise in Commvault. Proven experience in managing, monitoring, and resolving incidents related to backup and data recovery environments. Strong interest in ticket analysis, incident management, and proper escalation handling when required. Solid troubleshooting skills and ability to perform root cause analysis for technical issues. Experience with backup, restore, replication, and data retention processes. Knowledge of enterprise storage and data protection environments. Strong problem-solving skills and a continuous service improvement mindset. Excellent communication and teamwork skills in multicultural environments. Academic background in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

To hear more about the Senior Platform Engineer role , get in touch with Sophie Higginson at Anson McCade. AMC/SHI/SPE

review_candidates.title: Senior Associate, Direct Materials Procurement
review_candidates.description: On behalf of our client, Philip Morris International , we are looking for motivated candidates for the position of Senior Associate, Direct Materials Procurement . This position involves leading the procurement of Direct Materials to ensure reliable and uninterrupted supply in line with PMI requirements and evolving market conditions. The role is responsible for implementing global category strategies and regional procurement activities, from supplier selection and sourcing through contract negotiation and management, with a focus on supply security and flexibility, cost efficiency, sustainability, and responsible sourcing. Responsibilities: Develop and implement global and regional Direct Materials (DIM) category strategies and sourcing models aligned with business needs, market conditions, material availability and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO). Manage strategic supplier relationships across the full supplier lifecycle, including supplier selection, qualification, performance management, business reviews, negotiations and continuous improvement. Ensure supply continuity and manage supply-related risks through proactive risk assessment, mitigation measures and Business Continuity Plans (BCPs) for critical materials. Drive cost efficiency, pricing and productivity initiatives, optimizing sourcing models, supplier capabilities, processes and commercial agreements while supporting effective budget and price forecasting. Lead and support cross-functional initiatives to standardize and simplify materials, specifications and procurement processes, delivering cost-efficient solutions and improving operational efficiency. Ensure compliance with PMI standards, policies, legal requirements, EHS practices and responsible sourcing principles, while supporting sustainability initiatives across the supplier base. Provide accurate DIM data, analysis and strategic support to Finance, Manufacturing, Quality, Logistics, Product Development, Supply Chain Planning and other key stakeholders. Build strong cross-functional relationships, align priorities, proactively communicate risks and performance, and lead effective resolution of operational and supplier-related issues. Requirements: University degree in Economics, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain Management or a related field. Minimum 2 years of professional experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain or a related function, preferably within a multinational environment. Experience in strategic sourcing, category management, supplier relationship management, negotiations and supplier performance management. Upper-intermediate English proficiency, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills Good negotiation and data-analysis skills
